verses.gurmukhi: ਮਦ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਿਧਾ ਪਾਇਕੈ ਕੁਤੇ ਦਾ ਮਾਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: madh vich ridhaa paikai kute dhaa maasu|

en.bdb: The meat of dog cooked in the wine was, along with its foul smell, kept in the human skull.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਿਆ ਮਾਣਸ ਖੋਪਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੰਦੀ ਵਾਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: dhariaa maanas khoparee tis ma(n)dhee vaasu|

en.bdb: It was covered with the blood stained cloth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤੂ ਭਰਿਆ ਕਪੜਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਜਣੁ ਤਾਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: ratoo bhariaa kapaRaa kar kajan taasu|

en.bdb: Covering thus, the scavenger woman (chi:than) after appeasing her lust was carrying that bowl.

verses.gurmukhi: ਢਕਿ ਲੈ ਚਲੀ ਚੂਹੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: ddak lai chalee choohaRee kar bhog bilaasu|

en.bdb: On being asked about (the abominable covered material)
She cleared the doubt by saying that she had covered the meat to hide

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਪਵੈ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣੁ ਮਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੯॥
verses.translit_en: nadharee pavai akirataghan mat hoi vinaas ||9||

en.bdb: It from the sight of an ungrateful person to avoid its pollution.
